before.label: Without a clear plan
items: Processes live in people's heads and in spreadsheets.
Systems are bought before anyone agrees what they must do.
Repetitive manual work takes hours a machine could do.

after.label: With Practeva
items: Processes mapped and improved, so everyone sees what will change.
Systems chosen against requirements the business has agreed.
Repetitive work automated where it pays for itself.

services.name: Requirements
services.detail: Elicited, analysed and written up as user stories, acceptance criteria and requirements documents your builders can work from.

services.name: Process mapping and improvement
services.detail: How work flows today and how it should flow, with the handoffs and delays made visible and removed.

services.name: Process automation
services.detail: Finding the repetitive, rule-based work worth automating, and specifying the bots and workflows that take it on.

services.name: Digital transformation
services.detail: A roadmap for moving work onto digital systems, in an order your people and budget can carry.

services.name: Business systems
services.detail: Choosing the systems that run the business and comparing vendors against what it actually needs.

services.name: Operational improvement
services.detail: Turnaround times, controls and handoffs, measured and improved so the work runs with less friction.

services.name: Feasibility
services.detail: Whether an idea, product or change is worth doing, and what it would take to deliver.

services.name: Stakeholder workshops
services.detail: Interviews and workshops that get the right people to agree on what is needed.

services.name: Testing and go-live
services.detail: User acceptance testing that checks what is delivered matches what was agreed.

engagement.detail: We hear what you are working on

engagement.name: Findings presented
